owner: CC builds; Akien owns whether a boat riding a superseded intention is ended or re-parented.
intention: Let an intention be superseded or deprecated as a MACHINE-READABLE state, and make that state impossible to pass silently while boats ride it: the deprecating hand gets a report of what is riding (with its own blindness declared), and any boat still riding is refused at its next forward crossing, naming the supersession.
why: Akien, 2026-08-18, reasoning from the graph trees: 'if an intention got superceeded or otherwise depricated, we'd have to also review it's children or in flight whatevers.' Then the correction that shaped the build — 'the ticket is supposed to say what it's intention is already, so that IS the link back, yes?' It is. `owning_intention` is the edge and reversing it is a scan over a directory, so NO BIDIRECTIONAL LINK IS BUILT: the graph tree needed both directions because it is large and in a database; 162 files in git do not, and a stored back-edge would be a second copy of a fact that already exists, with two writers and a drift mode. THE GAP WAS NEVER THE LINK — it is that nothing traverses it and, more basically, that nothing can be superseded at all. MEASURED 2026-08-18: zero of 56 charters carry any supersession or deprecation state; 21 mention the words somewhere in prose, which is exactly the shape `owner` had before `gated_by` — the fact exists in English and nothing can read it. So there is no event, and with no event the only remaining mechanism is a sweep, which is the drift this system names by hand.
how: THREE PIECES, and the second is the one that makes the third honest. (1) STATE: charters gain a machine-readable supersession field — the successor's address and the date — written as an ADDITION, never by rewriting the charter's existing prose to say it was always this way (the discipline ruling-door-supersede-path established for ruling packets, cited rather than extended). (2) THE REVERSE READ WITH ITS BLINDNESS DECLARED: harbor_master gains `boats_riding(intention_address)` — the reverse of `boat_owner_of`, same discipline (files only, no daemon, no registry, no network), returning both the boats it found AND the count of in-flight tickets it could not attribute because they carry no `owning_intention`. A scan that reports only what it found is the exact hollow this node exists to forbid. (3) THE REFUSAL, AT A DOOR THAT IS ALREADY OPEN: harbor_master.clearance already resolves boat -> ticket -> owning_intention -> charter -> gated_by, so it is already holding that charter open. It reads one more field. A boat whose owning intention has been superseded is refused at its next forward crossing, naming the supersession and the successor. NOT AT THE CHARTER-WRITE DOOR, and the reason is load-bearing: recompile_gate.sh never blocks its caller and always exits 0 by charter, because that is what makes it safe to fire on every write — putting a refusal there would destroy the property that makes it usable.
gates: PROOF GATE: tester — proofs beside the code at cairn/devices/harbor_master/proofs/, run twice, sealed under TesterDevice().run_proof with isolation='netns', VALIDATION persisted beside the code. RED FIRST IS REQUIRED: the proof must fail on the unmodified tree on exactly the arms the defect owns, or the green is evidence about the fixture. ENTRY: buildme_rides_the_chart (a berthed validate packet claiming this ticket). EXIT: proved_answers_the_chart (a complete passing verdict artifact). EMISSION: WatchmeEmissionRed (the probe armed before the WATCHME crossing). CLEARANCE: harbor_master.clearance.clear for the forward crossing into PROVED — owning intention is cairn/devices/harbor_master/intention+why.json, verified 2026-08-18 to carry gated_by and so not among the 41 charters that would refuse.
falsifier: Mark an intention superseded while a boat rides it, then: (a) that boat's next forward crossing REFUSES, naming the supersession and the successor; (b) the deprecation-time scan names that boat; (c) that scan reports how many in-flight tickets it could NOT attribute. Any of the three missing kills it. WRONG-SHAPE, the specific hollow: the scan reports 'no boats riding, clear to supersede' while in-flight tickets carry no owning_intention — a green earned by not being able to see. Today that would be a clean report over 28 boats with 44 invisible. SECOND WRONG-SHAPE: the supersession recorded by editing the charter's existing prose in place, so a record of truth is rewritten to say it was always this way.
horizon: the first live supersession of an intention that has boats riding it
children: 44 in-flight tickets carry no owning_intention (measured 2026-08-18, against 28 that do; 64 closed tickets also lack it and are out of scope — a review of what is RIDING does not care about landed boats). NOT CAST: the backfill needs a per-ticket judgement about which intention actually owns each boat, and several of the 44 may honestly have none, which is a question for the corpus rather than a chore for a script. THIS NODE DELIBERATELY DOES NOT DEPEND ON IT — see design_choice below.
design_choice_the_node_turns_on: THE SCAN DECLARES ITS BLINDNESS INSTEAD OF REQUIRING A CLEAN CORPUS FIRST. The alternative — backfill all 44, then build the review — makes the mechanism wait on a chore, and makes its first green a claim about coverage nobody re-measures afterwards. Declaring the blind count means the mechanism is honest at 28/72 today and improves monotonically as the field fills, with the number visible in every report. It is the same move as labelling a coarse measurement coarse rather than waiting to build the instrument (Law 10's operative distinction).

watchme.trigger: every supersession of an intention — the act of writing the supersession field to a charter. Fires on the act; no clock, no sweep, no daemon.
watchme.enough: three live supersessions in which the scan's blind count was reported alongside its findings AND no boat riding a superseded intention reached a forward crossing without being refused. Three because a supersession of an intention with zero boats proves nothing about the interesting case, and the blind count earns trust only once it has been non-zero and acted on. EARLY STOP if the first supersession shows the refusal firing on a boat the scan had missed — that is the blindness being real, and it converts the child above from a chore into the next build.
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier, carrying the scan's output VERBATIM — findings and blind count together, because a scan reported as only what it found is the shape this node forbids
watchme.nexus: the harbor_master's own tree; the deprecation report is the consumer surface
watchme.consumer: the hand superseding the intention, who is deciding whether to proceed, and Akien, who owns whether a riding boat is ended or re-parented

intent_berth: none, because this node arose inside a design conversation on 2026-08-18 that walked up from a cgroup to the ownership graph; its durable referent is the sorted berth above and CairnCommons/slates/2026-08-18-the-heartbeat-is-the-managers-now.json.
provenance: Cast 2026-08-18. THE DESIGN GOT SMALLER TWICE BY READING RATHER THAN REASONING. First: I proposed the enforcement at the charter-write door before opening it; recompile_gate.sh never blocks its caller and always exits 0 by deliberate charter, so a refusal there would have broken the property that makes it safe to fire often — the refusal moved to a gate already holding the charter open. Second: I sized the coverage gap at 108 of 162 tickets, which was the wrong denominator; 64 are closed and irrelevant to what is RIDING, so the real figure is 44 in-flight blind against 28 attributable — smaller in count, worse in ratio, and it is the number the blindness declaration publishes.

distinctions_recorded.the_edge_already_exists_and_needed_no_tw: Akien's read, and the corpus agrees. `owning_intention` on the ticket IS the back-link; only an INDEX was missing, and an index over 162 git files is a scan. The graph-tree precedent does not transfer because its why was scale and a database. Recording this because the appealing move — mirror the pattern that worked elsewhere — would have added a second writer for a fact already stored once.
distinctions_recorded.a_notice_surface_is_not_a_gate: recompile_gate.sh fires on every charter write and looks like the obvious host for this check. It is not one: it exits 0 always, by charter, and that is the feature. The two roles must not be collapsed — Law 7 keeps them apart at exactly this seam (loud in the record, quiet at the surface), and a gate needs the opposite.
distinctions_recorded.supersede_without_rewriting_the_record: Taken from ruling-door-supersede-path (retired 2026-08-15), which solved this for misfiled ruling packets: open_ruling rewriting the same id would have ERASED Akien's act, so the correction took a new id and the original stayed on disk unaltered. Different object, same discipline. The pattern is cited, not grafted.
distinctions_recorded.the_blind_count_is_the_tooth_not_a_court: A review that reports clean over the boats it can see, while 44 sit invisible, is a green earned by not looking — the coin-toss-red shape this corpus names elsewhere. In this build the coverage number travels inside the report rather than beside it, so it cannot be dropped at the seam the way a caveat is.

open_at_cast.what_a_superseded_intention_does_to_a_bo: The gate refuses and names the supersession. Whether the boat is ended, re-parented onto the successor, or allowed through anyway is an owner's decision (Law 6), and this node does not decide it. The refusal is a stop, not a verdict on the work.
open_at_cast.an_intention_with_no_owning_boats_is_ind: The blind count makes this visible rather than solving it. Until the 44 are attributed, 'no boats riding' always means 'none among the 28 I can see'.
open_at_cast.whether_supersession_needs_a_door_of_its: Today the supersession is a charter field a hand writes, gated by that charter's gated_by like any other charter write. If supersession turns out to need its own intake (a packet, a reason, a successor that must resolve), that is a later node — not built now, because build-minimal, and because one live supersession will say more than the speculation would.
